errors.evidence: The description states that the y-axis tick interval is 1%. However, the labeled ticks are at 74, 76, 78, and 80, indicating an interval of 2%.

The description reports the F1 value at x=6 as approximately 77.7%. However, the data point at x=6 is visually at the same level as the point at x=2, which the description reports as 77.8%. The value is closer to 77.8%.

The description reports the Accuracy (Acc) value at x=2 as approximately 76.5%. This is the same value reported for x=4. Visually, the data point at x=2 is clearly lower than the point at x=4. The value at x=2 is closer to 76.4%.

The description reports the Accuracy (Acc) value at x=6 as approximately 76.6%. Visually, this data point is at the same level as the point at x=4, which is reported as 76.5%. Reporting it as 76.6% is a slight overestimation and inconsistent with the value at x=4.
